title: Adding your own model
text: deliberately simple model: degree-day snowpack feeding one linear reservoir, runoff reduced PET.
code: snow_bucket <- wsva_model(   id = "snowres", name = "Snow + linear reservoir",   bounds = param_bounds(ddf = c(0.5, 8),     # melt factor (mm/C/day)                         k = c(2, 200),       # reservoir time constant (days)                         et = c(0, 1)),       # fraction of PET removed   build = function(x, n_layers) {     p_in <- x$daily$prcp_mm; t <- x$daily$tmean_c; pet <- x$daily$pet_mm     snow_frac <- t < x$static$jtemp_c     function(par) {       swe <- 0; water <- numeric(length(p_in))       for (i in seq_along(p_in)) {         if (snow_frac[i]) swe <- swe + p_in[i]         melt <- if (t[i] > 0) min(swe, par$ddf * t[i]) else 0         swe <- swe - melt         water[i] <- max((if (snow_frac[i]) 0 else p_in[i]) + melt - par$et * pet[i], 0)       }       route_ihacres(water, tau_q = par$k, tau_s = par$k, vs = 0)     }   },   reference = "Vignette example") register_model(snow_bucket)
